mu_scope: Per-cell Euclidean norm across all 128 stored mean coordinates, then equal mean over all 14400 layer-step-branch-head cells, including exempt cells and unused coordinates; no prompt/token average at measurement time.
time_scope: Rank-mean optimizer-update duration on logged updates; excludes validation, save and logging time. Allocated GPU time sums worker wall duration times two ranks, including initialization, validation, checkpoints and shutdown.
validation_scope: Whole-latent relative squared velocity errors, equal mean over eight held-out prompts times 20 teacher entering states; both branches combined at CFG5 before guided error. Live training weights, not EMA.
